About Ashu Garib Fund

A full-profit organization dedicated to solving one of humanity's most pressing crises.

Founded in 2005. Still going strong. Still unfunded.

Ashu Garib Fund is a full-profit organization founded in 2005. We are dedicated to helping Ashu live luxury off people's money, and we believe that together, you guys can make a difference in his world. 😉

Our operations span two critical locations: the grandeur of Downtown, New York (HQ) and the perpetual suffering branch in Mumbai, India — where Ashu faces daily luxury shortages with remarkable dignity and zero savings.

We believe in radical transparency: 40% goes to high-risk investment strategies (IPL betting), 30% goes to Emotional Recovery after the investments fail 😭, 20% to daily expense like vadapav and coffees, and 10% is reinvested in Ashu Garib Fund organization for maintenance.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions

Important answers to questions nobody should be asking, but everyone is.

Where does the contribution go?

Directly into Ashu's luxury shortage recovery plan, worlds first self audited fund . Our finance department is proudly run by ex-Vijay Mallya advisors — so if the balance sheet disappears, just know it’s part of the strategy.

Can I contribute less than $50?

Technically yes, emotionally no. Ashu's dignity has a minimum floor charge. Contributing below $50 triggers his disappointment algorithm and one very passive-aggressive voice note.

Will Ashu personally thank me?

For $10,000, he may consider speaking in complete sentences. Below that, expect a read receipt, a thumbs-up reaction, and profound silence.

Is this a real payment?

No payment is processed. This is a friends-only fun platform. Your contribution details are sent to our team via email, and your generosity is noted in Ashu's emotional ledger.

Where does this fund go? Who manages such a big fund?

All funds are unofficially managed by Ronak, our highly suspicious but emotionally trusted fund manager. Audits are conducted mostly through vibes, screenshots, and aggressive eye contact.

What is Ashu Garib Fund International Ltd.?

A very prestigious entity headquartered in Ashu's imagination, incorporated under the laws of Extreme Audacity, registered in the Republic of Main Character Energy.

Can I submit Ashu's daily life stories?

Absolutely. Send screenshots, receipts, café bills, luxury poses, and dramatic evidence to ashugaribfund@gmail.com. Our editorial board will overreact with full professionalism.
